about: Sighting cards: the one glass card shown while an Instrument is in the Alidade's hairs. 'line' is the header exactly as printed (KIND · WORK · VALUE). The rows are LAMP, WEAK and CARRIES and no others. 'lamp' holds one reading per state; the state word is printed, then the reading. 'read' is one plain sentence under the rows.

lamp.wary: WARY · something is at its pans
lamp.hostile: HOSTILE · it will clear the sluice

cards.read: It opens and shuts the sluices on its own tide. Leave the pans whole and it leaves you be.
It paints the line where the ground is meant to be, and tells every Instrument within 60 m where you stand.
